What is Make It Yours?

Not just a phone case.

Make It Yours turns your own photos and designs into a phone case, printed for you at the vending machine in as little as three minutes.

  • Live preview
  • Professional printer
  • Automatic order queuing

Inspired by Tokyo's Akihabara culture and modern minimalist retail.
